answer: A vault is opened by one falcon that signs no other vault, and every later key must extend that vault. Its kth identity requires k further falcon, each staking one sable in escrow; the tenth needs ten falcon and ten sable, and ten need 55 of each. A falcon stakes once ever and its sable is forfeited if the backed identity defects, so no sponsor covers two admissions and parallelism buys no discount.
